inputs.text: This is a stark reminder of how democracy gets twisted to serve the rich and powerful at the expense of everyone else. In Nigeria, political parties that were supposed to give ordinary people a voice and push for public good are now turning into gated clubs for the wealthy elite. The ruling APC's moves ahead of the 2027 elections show exactly how the system locks out working people, the poor, and marginalized communities from real representation. It's not just a local problem—it's structural inequality doing what it always does, concentrating power in the hands of a tiny group while the rest of us get shut out and left to deal with the fallout. We need to call this what it is and fight for reforms that actually prioritize labor rights and protect the vulnerable instead of letting the wealthy rewrite the rules.
